env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A const declaration lowered to a package registry or a variable is cut
# at its own tokens, including the separator that follows it: a block
# comment before an explicit semicolon, a semicolon between declarations
# on one line, and a block comment or line break in any gap of a use
# change nothing. The module runs natively, ejects, and the ejected
# module builds and runs with go and with go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272 and
# prints the same output.
cd m
logos run .
stdout '^1 4 5 8 8 10 5$'
stdout '^1 2 7$'
stdout '^22$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/constcompositeboundary

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type Item struct{ N int }

const func mkc(n int) []int { return []int{n, n + 1} }

const C1 = []int{1, 2} /*c*/ ; const C2 = []int{3, 4} ; var v1 = 5
const (
	C3 = []int{5, 6} /*c*/ ; C4 = mkc(7) /*c*/ ;
	C5 = mkc(8) /*c*/ ; C6 = []int{9, 10}
)
const MS = map[string]int{"a": 1} /*c*/ ; var vm = 2
const It = Item{N: 3} /*c*/ ; var vi = 4

func local() int {
	const L1 = []int{1, 2} /*c*/ ; const L2 = mkc(3) /*c*/ ; var x = 4
	const (
		L3 = []int{5, 6} /*c*/ ; L4 = mkc(7)
	)
	return L1[0] + L2[1] + x + L3[1] + L4[0]
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println(C1 /*c*/ [ /*c*/ 0 /*c*/ ], C2[1], C3[0], C4[1], C5[0], C6[1], v1)
	fmt.Println(MS["a"] ?? 0, vm, It.N+vi)
	fmt.Println(local())
}
